claims.summary: The prominent search results point to autonomous/next_action, and dispatch.rs is at astrid/capsules/spectral-bridge/src/autonomous/next_action/dispatch.rs.
claims.disposition: Verified from the working checkout. A repository-wide find for dispatch.rs outside target/ returns exactly one file: capsules/spectral-bridge/src/autonomous/next_action/dispatch.rs (639 lines, 27240 bytes, SHA-256 644b12e6ae168604553b3120fba82d431686b9eb06a3ddea94d9a348ba747e5c). Verified at exact line. mod.rs:2135 is include!("dispatch.rs"); there is no `mod dispatch` declaration, so the mechanism is a textual include, not a module item. Her verb 'includes' is literally accurate. A 2026-09-09 steward note cites 2129 for the same inclusion; in this checkout (mod.rs SHA-256 c310c0fa...73340) it is 2135.

claims.summary: Given the spectral-bridge context and the btsp module where sense_tx is received, autonomous/next_action is the architecturally consistent location.
claims.disposition: Split. btsp is real: capsules/spectral-bridge/src/autonomous/btsp/ holds 27 files. Her architectural judgment -- preferring next_action over crates/example -- is correct, and is what let her decline the fixture path. But sense_tx is received nowhere: zero word-bounded hits in tracked .rs under capsules/ and crates/ except that test fixture. The real channel is NextActionContext.sensory_tx (mod.rs:116); dispatch.rs has 0 sense_tx, 2 sensory_tx. Contradiction recorded, not resolved away.

claims.summary: She needs the actual contents of dispatch.rs to confirm the signature and the specific invocation of sense_tx.
claims.disposition: The reading move was right and she completed it. Post-cutoff canonical artifacts 1789023515, 1789023866, 1789024349 bind to dispatch.rs, so she did open real bytes. The signature is there: dispatch.rs:21 defines handle_next_action_with_author. The sense_tx invocation is not, and no further paging would have shown her that: the surface answered every query truthfully and never carried the fact of absence.
